newsitem.title: UK: Med Aframax tankers firm, most other sectors flat.
newsitem.headline: Med Aframax tankers firm, most other sectors flat.

text.p: Mediterranean Aframax (80,000-tonne) dirty tanker rates firmed on Monday on increasing demand, but most other sectors were little changed, brokers said.
"There's a lot of demand (for Med Aframaxes). The way it's going they could rise even further over the week," one broker said.
He said Med Aframaxes had risen to W120 from about W107.5 after half a dozen vessels were fixed on subjects on Friday.
Very large crude carriers (VLCCs) were unchanged but firm at W80 from the Middle East Gulf to Japan and Singapore.
VLCCs from West Africa to the U.S. were steady to slightly firmer at W67.5, while Suezmaxes (130,000 tonners) on this route were little changed at W85, brokers said.
The North Sea was quiet with Aframaxes still at about W100, while Caribs/upcoast 70,000 tonne cargoes continued to fetch about W122.5.
